Every connected d-regular base graph d>=2 has the negative witness for every h>2/(d+2). Exact eigenvector and Perron sign conjugacy give max Laplacian eigenvalue d+2. value.rationale: Full edge subdivisions form a natural incidence-based coupled-site/edge diffusion model. Universality of the sharp threshold across every connected d-regular source graph, topology-independent failure witness, and strict separation of entrywise positivity from spectral contractivity provide an exact structural classification and a reusable positive-integration benchmark. For d>=3 the allowable positive RK4 timestep improves sharply over Euler by factor 2d/(d+2).
